title: Al with a defect: the low-level Landauer calls
summary: The Landauer transmission and DOS of an Al supercell with a defect in its middle, written with the low-level PAOFLOW.Transport calls one by one (partition, blocks, tuning, energy grid, self-energies, Green functions). The QE runs of your own supercell are not part of the case.

steps.label: Landauer transmission and DOS of the conductor with the defect
steps.note: needs output/qe/al.save of your own Al supercell (pw.x, then projwfc.x with lwrite_overlaps = .true.); writes output/paoflow/ (files with the postfix _defect)
